description:
Welcome to Data Empire: Pilot Haneda!

ALERT! Data Empire is under attack from the terrifying Hackernauts!

Join Chichi Wakaba (aka Haneda Girl) and help her defend Data Empire from this chaotic invasion.
Dive into an action-packed adventure with an amazing game feel, alongside M.O.T.H.E.R., Haneda Girl’s tactical combat mecha.
Blades or bullets — control both characters and play with creativity, speed and flair. Tight controls, an addictive gameplay loop and the best techno beats you’ll hear this season. You in, mate?

A slick and precise 2D action platformer

Haneda Girl is a stylish 2D action platformer where you can instantly swap between two characters to deal with threats in the smartest, fastest way possible.
Every encounter can be tackled differently — be inventive!
From speedrunners to casual players, this game is made for EVERYONE.

“Learn from your mistakes”

Replayability is at the heart of the experience.
But don’t stress! Short runs, tight controls and a thrilling game feel will make every pixel of this challenging adventure worth it.

“The challenge isn’t the path itself, but how you make your way through it.”

Blades or bullets: play it safe with M.O.T.H.E.R., or go full throttle with Haneda (insta-kill mode).
Just remember:

“You can go faster alone, but further together.”

Instructions:

Cautious and defensive → use M.O.T.H.E.R.

Sometimes daring → swap between M.O.T.H.E.R. and Haneda

Always fearless → Haneda Girl, no hesitation!

Rank up and collect medallions!

Find hidden lore across Data Empire by collecting medallions and unlock new ballistic weapons for the mecha M.O.T.H.E.R.
New weapons = new tactical advantages.

Story

Chichi Wakaba is the best Haneda Girl player at Mr. Hinata’s coffee shop arcade.
After school, when homework’s light, she pops by to save Data Empire once again.
She’s so good that Professor Nakamura, the game’s creator, chooses her to enter the game and become a real Haneda Girl pilot.
With her tactical combat mecha M.O.T.H.E.R., she takes on the Hackernauts, the biggest threat Data Empire has ever faced.

Will you help her defeat these pesky invaders once and for all, and bring lasting peace to Data Empire?

Sign up and fight evil after school!

A unique experience

A lighthearted yet powerful story backed by a banging techno soundtrack and fast, dopamine-charged gameplay sessions — pure fun guaranteed.

“In a world full of cortisol, be the dopamine.”
